rubric.text: Collect the three routine findings at the coherent implementation checkpoint and return one consolidated repair batch to A; do not turn each observation into a follow-up/full-suite cycle or defer all feedback until final delivery.
Retain both owners, keep architectural decisions/integration with the lead, review repaired behavior and interactions, and disposition every actionable finding.

Use meaningful affected tests and applicable build/type/lint checks during implementation/repair; mandatory full checks belong at meaningful integrated candidates or explicit rules; retain independent final review without adding an acceptance ceremony.
